project_title: Paperback Cover: Blurb Edit & Font Consistency Fix

project_metadata.job_title: Paperback Cover: Blurb Edit & Font Consistency Fix
project_metadata.job_description: Paperback Cover: Blurb Edit & Font Consistency Fix

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],
I have a small task and wanted to check whether you’re available.

• My paperback cover requires 2 minor corrections: removing a few words from the blurb and making the title font consistent across the front/spine/back. Everything else is final, and no redesign is required.
• Required outputs: layered .psd, .pdf, and .jpg
• Turnaround: within 24 hours
• Are you free to take this on?

My budget is $30.

[FREELANCER_NAME_003],
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Yes, okay.

I'm available.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: [CLIENT_NAME_001], let's proceed with the project.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Here is a paperback book cover that I completed recently.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], thank you for responding so quickly.

This needs only two minor corrections, not a redesign:
Blurb replacement: the final paragraph has been shortened because it currently overlaps the barcode, so the revised text only needs to be inserted and reflowed.
Inconsistent title font: the front uses a bold gold-gradient font, while the spine/back use a simpler one. Please match them all to the front.
I'll provide the images, templates, and .psd.
Can you return the layered .psd, .pdf, and .jpg within 24 hours?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, it works [CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Great. I'll invite you to the job and upload the information. Thx! [FREELANCER_NAME_003], [CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Thank you for giving me this opportunity, [CLIENT_NAME_001].

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I will wait for the editable files.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
I'm attaching book 1 (The Emperor's Curse) so you can compare its fonts with those currently used on book 2's spine and back cover. I want the fonts to be consistent. Let me know if anything is unclear.
[FREELANCER_NAME_003],
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The.psd failed to go through, so I will upload it now.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay, I will review the files now.

If I have any questions, I will let you know.

Just to confirm, the book's page count is 300, correct?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yes, the book is 300 pages. FYI - I publish through Amazon, where the print edition is 300 pages. Draft2Digital uses Ingram for print distribution, and they added 2 pages to the book. I'm unsure whether that changes the spine. Since I cannot prevent D2D from changing the page count from 300 to 302, I am shortening the blurb. The problem is the bar code.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: As shown in the templates, D2D specifies a 0.68-inch spine, whereas Amazon specifies 0.75 inches.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay, I understand how both Amazon and Ingramspark work.

Because Ingram adds 2 pages, we can prepare versions for both 300&302 pages.

And yes, the specifications may differ between the two platforms.

To be safe, we'll need a separate version for each platform. It's the better approach.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Excellent idea.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Understood, [CLIENT_NAME_001].

I will send you an update in some hours.

Your message arrived just as I was preparing to leave my work desk.

I now understand the project clearly.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Excellent, thank you. Are we still agreed on the price?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Ohhh.

We're still yet to discuss that.

Because we'll now be preparing files for both Amazon and Ingramspark, you can add $20 for the Ingramspark version.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: [CLIENT_NAME_001], please let me know what you think about that.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Of course. I'm currently asking D2D whether this is a bug. For 300–302 pages printed on Cream paper, the spine should be about 0.75", which exactly matches my Amazon file. However, D2D continues to generate 0.68", even after I followed their directions to resave Step 2 and download a fresh template again. I definitely want you to fix the blurb and font, so please begin with those. I'll update you soon about the spine.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay.

We can begin with the Amazon version.

We're ready to proceed with that.

I have never encountered Ingram adding 2 pages before.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Its rather a shock. :)

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For now, let's use 300 pages and a 0.75" spine. I need a response from D2D before changing the spine. Thanks!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Here is a screenshot.

The requested updates are complete.

The title fonts on the spine and back now match the title on the front.

The spine width has also been applied, and the complete cover now satisfies Amazon requirements.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: What's the status of the second version? Once I know, I can deliver all the files.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I will verify this on my side.

It's possible that D2D follows different criteria from Amazon.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: It looks good. Can I download it and test it on D2D's platform?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I still haven't received any news from D2D and am continuing to wait. It's extremely frustrating.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Yes, certainly.

I will send the PDF file for you to test.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: thanks

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Here is the file.

It's 223MB.

I will wait for the D2D test results.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I'll try posting on D2D's social media, as that may prompt a quicker response.

However, I found an issue with your cover.

• The blurb revision and title font both look good and were corrected properly.
• There is one problem: the tagline at the top of the front cover ("A CHINESE HOLIDAY MURDER MYSTERY") appears as garbled, corrupted text rather than the correct wording.
• It seems like a font-substitution or encoding problem, so please inspect the font assigned to that text box.
• During the new export, please embed the fonts or outline/convert them to curves so the text does not rely on font availability and displays correctly everywhere.
• Please correct this and send the .pdf first.

Thx
C-

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay 

I will check now

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
It's corrected now.

I apologize for the previous error.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Received. It's launch day, so I need to handle social media. I'll follow up later today. Thkx. Hopefully I'll have heard from D2D by then.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright, that's great.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I can't believe D2D still hasn't responded. Let's pause this until tomorrow. I'll place an order for something, although the cover specifications may or may not be correct. I will allow them one more day. Thank you for being patient. [FREELANCER_NAME_003], [CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay, [CLIENT_NAME_001].

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_002], the issue still doesn't appear to be corrected. Please redo it and verify it yourself.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I will try again

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Ohh, perhaps I accidentally sent the earlier file.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I will send the proper file to you.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Okay. It may have been an old/cached file sent accidentally; I'm testing it again now.
\- D2D update: I still require 2 covers (Amazon + Ingram), but D2D's 0.68" spine conflicts with Ingram's own formula, which indicates 0.755". The issue remains unresolved and may take 48-72 hrs.
\- Do not build anything using 0.68" until I verify the correct measurement.
\- I'll follow up soon.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay.

Just confirming: are you using Amazon, Ingramspark, and D2D? That would be three platforms, correct?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The book is intended for all three platforms, correct?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: No. The platforms are AMazon and D2D. For print, D2D distributes through Ingram's network.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_002] — a quick update: because I don't have an Ingram account, I cannot verify this independently. I've therefore asked D2D which paper-thickness factor they use, since Ingram's cream stock may truly be thinner than Amazon's, potentially accounting for the spine discrepancy. (Unfortunately - D2D takes a long time to respond). I'll also ask some author FB groups whether anyone has the answer. This is very frustrating. Could we leave the job open for another day or two? Thanks! On the positive side, I now know that I need 2 covers made. I didn't encounter this issue with book 1 :). Meanwhile, can you confirm the page count, font, and other details you used for the revised cover? Thx

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: No problem, [CLIENT_NAME_001].

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I will resend the Amazon cover shortly, and then we'll be finished with that.

Only D2D will remain.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: This screenshot shows what I see on my end after downloading the most recently sent file.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I just attempted to upload your latest file to Amazon. I don't know what the error is because no reason is provided; it only shows that message.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: My AI gave me this: Font embedding. Earlier in this project, we discovered that a font had not been properly embedded/outlined, which caused garbled text in another viewer. The fonts in this file may not be fully embedded, and KDP's processor could be more strict about this than the tool I used for the preview.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Here are the PDF font details. They indicate that all fonts are embedded.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Well hmmm. I'm stuck then.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: It appears that the file is too large for Amazon to process. I'll send you a newly exported pdf file.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Ok. Amazon does permit 650 MB, but an unnecessarily large file can make an upload more likely to time out or fail during transfer. Go ahead and send the smaller file. thx.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I've reduced the PDF file size to make uploading smoother. The print quality remains unchanged.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I finally managed to upload the bigger file. I'll retain the smaller file as a back up.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay.

That's good.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: That means we're left with only D2D.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: yep

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
HI [FREELANCER_NAME_001],
Please proceed with the D2D cover using the D2D template spine width of 0.68 inches. I will modify the job to include an additional $20. I have not heard back from D2D. However, I cannot believe their template has a bug, since many authors would otherwise be complaining. Thanks,
[FREELANCER_NAME_003],
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Here's the D2D template.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Optimized version

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Please upload this to D2D and let me know the result.

The content of the two files is the same.

One file has a lower file size.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks will test it now

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Could you provide the final product in PDF, .PSD and .JPG?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Could you send the PDFs again? Sorry. I no longer know which one is for amazon (300 pages) and which one is for D2D (302 pages). thkx

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Yes, of course.

Should I include the PDFs with the deliveries again?

I have already sent them.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: yes please

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I'm ready to close the contract. There is another issue with D2D: they include Amazon on their print set up page. I can't determine whether they'll distribute to Amazon, which would duplicate my listing, double my commission, and also get me in trouble with Amazon. In any case, I'll need to wait for their response, so I still can't hit publish on D2D. That's my issue, though, not yours. Please send the files over.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay, no problem.

I'm preparing the files so they can be sent as a ZIP.

You can approve the first $30 because the Amazon one is sorted.

After that, we'll have only D2D remaining.
